item.skyabyss.tide_shell_armor.desc: Two pieces harden the shell; four wrap you in the tide's carapace. Stronger when wet, and light in the water
item.skyabyss.tide_shell_trident.desc: Long reach. The tide's jolt slows whatever it pierces
item.skyabyss.coral_shield.desc: While raised, it softens even blows it cannot stop. Coral thorns sting whoever strikes it
item.skyabyss.tide_chime_charm.desc: Ring it to send out a tidal jolt that pushes back and slows nearby foes (rests for 45 seconds)
item.skyabyss.tidecaller_claw.desc: Every third blow calls the tide and sends a line of water forward. Swings faster underwater
item.skyabyss.coral_harpoon.desc: Coral sprouts at the feet of whatever it pierces, holding it in place for a moment
item.skyabyss.moontide_pearl.desc: Worn in a trinket slot, it wraps you in a bubble shield when badly hurt (sleeps for 90 seconds after)
item.skyabyss.tide_shell_core.desc: A fragment of the tide shell's heart. Material for a future artifact
gui.skyabyss.forge.exchange_titan_hint: Switch which titan to trade for
gui.skyabyss.forge.exchange_no_clear.tid: Defeat the Tide Shell's Heart to unlock trading
gui.skyabyss.forge.exchange_all_owned.ti: You own every Tide Shell exclusive
skyabyss_gear.tooltip.short.shield: Level too low to raise it
